## Checklist
- [ ] Work is inside `<domain>/tasks/<date>-<name>/` (or a new domain was scaffolded from `templates/domain/`)
- [ ] Task README is complete: source of truth, sources visited, how to connect, research notes, obstacles and fixes, result, status
- [ ] Reusable problems are in `<domain>/troubleshooting/<slug>.md`; connection and source details are in the domain's living files
- [ ] `node scripts/validate.mjs` passes (generated indexes are up to date)
- [ ] No secrets, key files or real customer data (names of variables only)
- [ ] Commit messages follow `<type>(<scope>): <summary>`
